English: Yurt Camp
A cluster of felt yurts and tents forms the first steppe encampment, offering rudimentary shelter and a base for early settlement.
Pasture Pen
Fenced grazing lands close to the camp, allowing for basic animal husbandry and small herds to be kept safely.
Timber Palisade
A simple surrounding wall of sharpened timber stakes, giving the camp basic protection against raiders and wild beasts.
Stock Enclosure
Stone and timber enclosures for livestock and vital supplies, further securing wealth and increasing the settlements resilience.
Steppe Watchpost
Raised earth mounds and wooden towers, giving lookouts clear views across the plains, improving advance warning against attacks.
Horse Herding Ground
Vast fenced ranges dedicated to breeding and training horses, the pride of the steppe, providing swift cavalry for the defense of the settlement.
Steppe Village
A permanent settlement of wooden and earthen houses, with organized lanes and communal gathering areas, transforming the camp into a true village.
Trading Post
A bustling market hub, attracting merchants and caravans, and turning the settlement into a node of steppe commerce.
Steppe Fort
A formidable timber and earthwork fortress with multiple defensive rings, providing a true stronghold against invaders.
Nomad Bastion
A grand citadel of the open plains: stonework, reinforced ramparts, and a mighty keep serve as a symbol of authority and a secure seat of power on the steppe.
